posts.title: ptxNinja: decompilation for PTX (CUDA)
posts.description: ptxNinja is an architectural plugin that extends the functionality of Binary Ninja to support *.ptx files containing functions or kernels written in PTX. The PTX language is a low-level format used by NVIDIA for its CUDA-based GPUs. This plugin provides a lifter that translates raw instructions into the low-level instructions that Binary Ninja requires to begin analysis. This work was presented at

posts.title: Disassembling a binary: linear sweep and recursive traversal
posts.description: Building your own set of analysis tools is a great exercise for those who already have some basics in static analysis. It even allows you to later move on to implement more complex analyses in reverse engineering.
